question: The lubricating fluid found between the two bones at a movable joint is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**synovial**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A viscous fluid **found between **your joints **is called **synovial fluid **and is **also referred to as joint fluid**.
 
• When **you move your joints**, the **fluid cushions **the **ends **of the **bones and lessens friction**.
 
• A **series **of **tests **called a **synovial fluid **analysis look for conditions that **impact the joints**.
 
• **Synovial fluid**, also called **synovia**, is **a viscous, non-Newtonian fluid **found in the cavities of **synovial joints**. 
 
• Synovial fluid is **produced as an ultrafiltrate of blood plasma **and is **primarily composed of hyaluronan, lubricin, proteinase, collagenases, and prostaglandins**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Our brain **and **spinal cord **are **surrounded **by **cerebrospinal fluid **(CSF), **a clear, colorless, watery fluid**. **Our central nervous system **is **made up **of **your spinal cord and brain**. Your ability to **move, breathe, see, think, and other bodily functions **are **all coordinated **and **controlled by it**.
 
• **Amniotic fluid **is a **clear, slightly yellowish liquid **that surrounds the **unborn baby **(fetus) **during pregnancy**. It is **contained **in the **amniotic sac. Polyhydramnios **may occur when a **fetus cannot swallow **a **normal amount of amniotic fluid **due to **a gastrointestinal, neurological, or other problem**.
 
• **Interstitial fluid **found in the **spaces around cells**. It comes from **substances that leak out of blood capillaries **(the smallest type of blood vessel). It helps **bring oxygen and nutrients **to **cells and to remove waste products from them**.
